observations: Home showed the oldest five drafts above custom/recent work even with thirty newer accepted notes.
The local model opened the live review panel with open_reviews and completed in two steps. It made no business change.
Previous and Next navigated twenty plus five current drafts without duplicate entries.
Withdrawing the first inventory proposal preserved stock at twenty; Undo restored its draft. Acceptance applied minus two once; Undo restored twenty.
The first native inspection exposed Back traversing intermediate review versions. The final build replaces the current route after review actions.

After rebuilding and reopening, the final native check withdrew Planning note 05, displayed Withdrawn and returned to the review list in one Back action. Both withdrawn items were absent from current drafts.
Original history and final stock survived reopen. The final layout was visually inspected and the app quit normally.

limits: Schema 4 migrates canonical schema 1, 2 and 3 packages. Package manifest remains version 1. Older binaries cannot open upgraded databases; matching app/CLI versions are required. Only synthetic packages were migrated in this checkpoint.

The core schema suite passed eighty checks before draft withdrawal was added. The focused preview suite separately verifies withdrawal, idempotency, stale/accepted refusal, table non-effects, Undo, lineage and integrity.

One typed live-model request qualifies opening this list, not broad natural language, microphone, keyboard or VoiceOver use. Withdrawal is exposed through native review, exact current-item text commands and CLI, not a general model mutation tool.
Review entries contain current metadata, not original bodies or proof of business facts. Requests and table rows are excluded; table proposals represent their changes.
The warm in-memory query stress result is not a whole-app, disk, import, FTS or end-to-end scalability result.

Earlier engine parity, automatic compaction, references/backlinks, full J11, wider-device and distribution gates remain open. No broad model cohort, full installation suite or hosted CI was rerun for this checkpoint.
